name-only; not modelled in V1; removes players from projected lineups
no historical source; backtests use shift-derived deployment (lines, injuries and goalie-status history are only 4-5 days deep)
Projection distributions: PARTIAL; 20,000 team draws / 10,000 player draws, draws not persisted
Matchup metrics: RESEARCH (lambda decomposition per game per run; shadow and thesis layers are RESEARCH_ONLY)
